title: Open WebUI knowledge sync cleanup -- T1485 write-access-to-one-KB deletes files from another
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-70488 (GHSA-jxc9-xmc4-gr23,
CVSS 4.3 MEDIUM), affecting Open WebUI from 0.9.6 until 0.11.0.

The sync cleanup endpoint authorized WRITE access to the knowledge base
named in the URL, then acted on directory and file ids supplied in the
REQUEST BODY without checking that those objects actually belonged to
that same knowledge base. A user with write access to knowledge base A
could therefore delete directories and remove file embeddings from
knowledge base B, breaking retrieval and chat-with-file for the
targeted documents in a knowledge base they had no legitimate access
to -- a targeted-availability attack rather than a content-disclosure
one.

Detection logic flags a sync-cleanup request whose body-supplied
directory/file ids resolve to a DIFFERENT knowledge base than the one
named in the URL path and authorized against -- the specific
cross-object mismatch the vulnerable endpoint failed to check.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the exact fix commit and PR), fixed in 0.11.0.
